{{Quote|The Deftoi of Muntro VI in the Outer Rim are staging their decennial Otherworld Arts Festival. A new composition in their quasi-operatic ceremonial artform, which their formal request translates roughly as "highmind stagecraft," dramatizes a bloody period in Naboo's history before the Great Time of Peace.|An announcement from the Office of the [[Music Advisor/Legends|Music Advisor]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]|<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Arts Festival Requires Naboo Animals}} on Naboo</ref>}}
The '''Deftoi''' were individuals that inhabited the world [[Muntro VI]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="SWG" />

Every ten years, the Deftoi of Muntro VI organized their famous [[Otherworld Arts Festival]].<ref name="SWG" /> For the [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> edition of the festival, the Deftoi requested the Office of the [[Music Advisor/Legends|Music Advisor]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to provide carcasses of Naboo animals in order to hold a performance depicting the events of the [[Time of Suffering/Legends|Time of Suffering]] of Naboo.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Deftoi were first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The game did no clearly establish whether Deftoi referred to a title or a [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="SWG" />
